title: Nobody Asked
stamp: The denial arrived before the question.

scenes.text: Nobody asked whether we ignored the complaint. So, to be clear: we did not ignore the complaint.
Nobody asked whether anyone is steering us. We would like to confirm that nobody is steering us. Unprompted. For the record.
There’s an old line about protesting too much. We call it communications. Rule of thumb: when the answer arrives before the question, go and check the question.
